title: What Happens When an AI Agent Uses a Tool?
note: Scenes are anchored to narration words (starts_at), never to guessed seconds. Times are resolved from the real audio by contentos.production.sceneplan.resolve().

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.visual: Hook text 'Your AI model never runs a tool.' appears at frame 0; 'never' turns red; at 'It only asks.' the line dims and 'It only asks.' lands in amber while the MODEL node and an amber request packet pop in.
scenes.transition: Cold open on text (no intro animation); slow camera push-in

scenes.title: 1. A goal, plus tools
scenes.visual: Goal card ('Should I bring a jacket in Austin?') feeds the MODEL; tool list card appears; name, description and argument columns highlight in turn as they are spoken.
scenes.transition: Hook text dissolves; kicker '1 / A GOAL, PLUS TOOLS' slides in; camera pans toward the model and tool list

scenes.title: 2. The model asks
scenes.visual: get_weather row is selected, others dim; tool list is replaced by an ILLUSTRATIVE tool_use JSON block; name and input lines highlight; header badge 'just text' pulses at 'a description of a call'. Amber request packet appears at the MODEL.
scenes.transition: Tool list cross-fades into JSON; camera eases in

scenes.title: 3. Your app runs it
scenes.visual: YOUR APP and EXTERNAL SYSTEM nodes join the stage; request packet travels MODEL to YOUR APP to EXTERNAL SYSTEM; terminal panel logs the illustrative call; API / DB / SHELL chips light on their words.
scenes.transition: Nodes and connectors draw in; camera pans toward the external system

scenes.title: 4. The result comes back
scenes.visual: Terminal logs the response; green result packet travels back to the MODEL; tool_result JSON replaces the terminal, with the matching id highlighted; then a fork 'call another tool / give a final answer' selects 'final answer' and shows the reply.
scenes.transition: Packet return path mirrors the outbound path; camera settles

scenes.title: The loop
scenes.visual: Actors dissolve; a four-node ring ASK / RUN / OBSERVE / DECIDE draws itself, each node lighting on its spoken word; camera pulls back; 'AGENT' appears in the centre.
scenes.transition: Stage wipes to the ring; camera pull-back reveals the whole loop

scenes.title: Next
scenes.visual: Ring fades; end card 'UP NEXT: What happens when a tool call fails?' with a 'Watch next' pill.
scenes.transition: Ring dissolves into end card; end card holds to the last frame
